# Digital Rock Art Research

## CAA Special Interest Group
This CAA International Special Interest Group (SIG) focuses on enabling the development of new workflows for documentation, analysis, and data sharing that improve our understanding of the creation and consumption of rock art worldwide.

We are inclusive of all rock art, regardles of chronology, geography, or cultural context.

Interested in joining? Please contact us at XXXXXXX.

<!-- Highlight upcoming event or recent publication here. -->

## SIG Background
After a workshop on digital rock art research in Berlin (XXXX) and a successful session at CAA 2025 in Athens, we decided to propose a CAA Special Interest Group (SIG) on digital rock art research. The SIG was approved in 2026 at CAA Vienna.
